title: The Cannon Nobody Bought
sentences: The engineer behind the sultan's giant cannon offered his skills to the Byzantines first.
His name was Orban, a cannon maker from Hungary.
In 1452, Emperor Constantine the Eleventh could not afford his fee.
So Orban went to Sultan Mehmed the Second, who paid him well.
Accounts vary, but they describe a gun about eight meters long, firing stone balls of hundreds of kilos.
Oxen dragged it from Edirne to Constantinople.
In 1453, it was aimed at the city that turned him away.

shots.label: ACCOUNTS VARY

caption:
The man who built the sultan's giant cannon offered his skills to the Byzantines first. They couldn't afford him.
